content:
deploy-bot: Deploy started -> env=sandbox service=web-frontend tag=release-2026-03-19-rc2 commit=af3b1e4 initiated_by=@jordan. Canary=10% for 10m. changelog: https://git.internal/r/redwood/web-frontend/compare/release-2026-03-18..release-2026-03-19-rc2 :rocket:

jordan: Kicking this off. I'll watch metrics and canary logs.

priya: thx. plan: smoke after canary, then 50% roll if green.

deploy-bot: Canary complete (10m): status=warning rate=0.1% err spikes. Starting rollout to 50%.

sophia: @aman seeing a few 500s on /api/session in the canary logs, not huge but repeated.

aman: looking now. grabbing logs.

aman: stack snippet:
```
ERROR GatewayTimeout: upstream timed out after 30s
 at fetchUserSession (/svc/session/index.js:112)
```

ci-bot: Smoke result: auth-e2e FAILED (1/12). failing test: login-with-refresh-token.test.ts

priya: hmm. is this user visible? any customer impact?

jordan: metrics from canary show auth fail rate ~0.8% for last 5m, overall traffic small but test failing is worrying. recommend pause and rollback to previous stable tag unless Aman finds a quick fix.

aman: I see a regression in the token refresh flow tied to grpc timeout; not trivial to patch in the next 10m.

priya: agree — pause the rollout. @deploy-bot pause.

deploy-bot: Rollout paused by @priya at request of release lead. current rollout=50% paused.

jordan: Going to roll back sandbox to release-2026-03-18-v1. Creating rollback now.

jordan: rollback command:
```
./deploy rollback --env=sandbox --service=web-frontend --to-tag=release-2026-03-18-v1 --reason="smoke auth failures" --initiated-by=jordan
```

deploy-bot: Rollback started -> env=sandbox service=web-frontend target_tag=release-2026-03-18-v1 initiated_by=@jordan

deploy-bot: Rollback finished -> env=sandbox service=web-frontend status=success duration=192s tag=release-2026-03-18-v1 :white_check_mark:

ci-bot: Rerunning smoke after rollback...

ci-bot: Smoke result: all tests passed (12/12) :tada:

sophia: smoke looks green. verifying a few endpoints manually. /api/session 200 responses now.

priya: good catch team. we'll open a follow-up issue and pin canary criteria more strictly.

jordan: created ticket RED-3129 with logs and traces. tagging @eng-ml and @eng-runtime for postmortem.

aman: will dig into grpc timeout root cause tomorrow, adding logs to the ticket.

priya: thanks. we'll reschedule sandbox deploy after fix and a more conservative canary. :lock:
